The Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
Washington, D.C. 20543
Re: Exxon Mobil Corp. v. Corporación CIMEX, S.A.,
S. Ct. No. 24-699
Dear Mr. Harris:
I represent petitioner in the above-captioned case.  On behalf of both parties, I am
writing to request the following extensions of time for the merits briefs:
Brief for Petitioner:    November 28, 2025
Brief for Respondent:    January 9, 2026
Reply Brief for Petitioner:   February 6, 2026
Both parties have agreed to this propos ed schedule, which would allow the Court
to hold oral argument during th e February 2026 sitting.  Please  let me know if you need
any additional information.
Sincerely,
/s/ Jeffrey B. Wall
Jeffrey B. Wall
cc: Michael R. Krinsky, Esq.
 Rabinowitz, Boudin, Standard, Krinsky & Lieberman, P.C.
